svg.title: The calibrated contact spiral
svg.desc: An exact tuned square pyramid surrounds a sphere at left. Five sphere contacts are also four corners of one cube face and the center of its opposite face. Those contacts recursively become alternating, forty-five-degree-rotated child pyramids, shown magnified at right. Solid geometry is derived; a dashed returning arc marks the proposed recalibration step, not a discovered solid.
svg.metadata: {"kind":"vybn.calibrated_contact_spiral.v1","derived":{"root_aspect":"sqrt(2)","first_child_aspect":"1","passive_fixed_aspect":"sqrt((1+sqrt(2))/2)","passive_fixed_scale":"sqrt(2)-1","rotation_per_layer":"pi/4"},"invented":"the dashed metric-preserving return from biased passive recursion to the balanced cube-sphere-pyramid reference"}
svg.text: THE SHAPE WE CAN ACTUALLY DRAW
CUBE · SPHERE · FIVE CONTACTS · RECURSION · RETURN
cube + sphere + tuned five-contact pyramid · h/a = √2
preserve the metric; return without erasing the change
five contacts become the next body · the body changes · calibration keeps seeing from collapsing into bias
